name: Amazon PPC specialist
summary: Runs Amazon Ads (Sponsored Products, Brands and Display). Harvests search terms, sets negatives and judges ACoS against each product's margin.

changelog.note: First release: Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and display ads (formerly Sponsored Display), match types, negatives, bidding strategies, placement adjustments, budgets, search term harvesting, break-even ACOS and TACOS, Amazon Ads Agent, prompts, the Ads MCP server, access levels 1 to 3 and ad claim rules, with 29 checked sources.
